The workflow is valid. Here is the final answer:

workflow_id: wf_ft_006
steps:
  - id: authenticate
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      source: session_token
    output: user_context

  - id: read_nutrition_log
    op: read_database
    params:
      collection: nutrition_logs
      filters:
        user_id: "{{user_context.user_id}}"
        date: "{{today}}"
    output: nutrition_entries

  - id: aggregate_nutrition
    op: aggregate_data
    params:
      input: "{{nutrition_entries}}"
      fields:
        - name: total_calories
          function: sum
          field: calories
        - name: total_protein
          function: sum
          field: protein
        - name: total_carbs
          function: sum
          field: carbs
        - name: total_fat
          function: sum
          field: fat
    output: nutrition_totals

  - id: format_progress_summary
    op: format_output
    params:
      template: daily_progress_summary
      data:
        consumed: "{{nutrition_totals}}"
        daily_targets: "{{user_context.profile.daily_targets}}"
      comparisons:
        - metric: calories
          actual: "{{nutrition_totals.total_calories}}"
          target: "{{user_context.profile.daily_targets.calories}}"
        - metric: protein
          actual: "{{nutrition_totals.total_protein}}"
          target: "{{user_context.profile.daily_targets.protein}}"
        - metric: carbs
          actual: "{{nutrition_totals.total_carbs}}"
          target: "{{user_context.profile.daily_targets.carbs}}"
        - metric: fat
          actual: "{{nutrition_totals.total_fat}}"
          target: "{{user_context.profile.daily_targets.fat}}"
    output: progress_summary
